answer_1.quote: MobileSpeech is the first zero-shot TTS synthesis system that can be deployed on mobile devices.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate speaker similarity (SPK) between the original prompt and synthesized speech, we employ WavLM-TDNN. For assessing automatic speech recognition (ASR) performance, we conduct ASR on the generated audio and calculate the word error rate (WER) compared to the original transcriptions. To compute the real-time factor, we measure the ratio of the total length of generated speech to the total time taken by the model to generate the corresponding speech features.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation We conduct the MOS (mean opinion score) and CMOS (comparative mean opinion score) evaluation on the test set to measure the audio naturalness via crowdsourcing.
answer_4.guideline: We analyze the MOS in three aspects: MOS-Q (Quality: clarity, high-frequency, and original timbre reconstruction), MOS-P (Prosody: naturalness of pitch, energy, and duration), and MOS-S (Speaker similarity).
